title: Two-Plate Operating State
summary: FIG. 09 sets the six shifts on two flat plates side by side, a paper panel for 'without the system' and an ink plate for 'with it', and a Before | After control re-proportions the plates and swaps which voice leads. Both voices stay readable row against row, where today's site uses a static ✕/■ table.

reference.borrowed: V7's Before / With V7 block: the same claim put on two plates side by side, a muted plate for the old way and a saturated one for the new, each with its own small label and a quiet list. The contrast comes only from plate colour and voice, with no decoration.
reference.kelwin: V7's equal halves become two flat plates on the 12-column grid: a --panel paper plate (without the system) and an ink plate (with it), split 5 | 7 columns at rest. The plates face each other across a 24px gutter, with the six shifts aligned row against row on hairline rules. The without-voice is Mona light at normal width and the with-voice is the wide display cut. The leading plate sets its voice at 28px in --fg and the trailing plate at 17px in --fg-2, so both stay readable in any state. V7's dot-radio labels become mono plate heads, and the Plurel segmented control sits in the caption band. Selecting Before re-proportions the plates to 7 | 5 and hands the large voice to the paper plate. V7's ✕/✓ tiles and orange gradient are dropped, leaving no icons, cards or gradients. The plate's one red element is the K3 core of the real three-piece Kelwin mark (master geometry) in the ink plate's head. It seats only in the After state. The head follows the founder DNA: red-square label, 96px two-voice 'Same activity. / Different system.' (from the source coda), a 48×2 red rule, the source lede, and the bottom-right annotation ('■ The difference') carrying the source coda.

motion: entrance: the label row fades in (300ms). 'Same activity.' then 'Different system.' rise out of their masks (800ms --ease-out, with the light line 200ms later). The 48×2 red rule draws, then the lede and the annotation fade up 12px. The two plates wipe open top-down (800ms, the ink plate 120ms after the paper one) in the Before arrangement: paper plate 7 columns leading in the large light voice, ink plate 5 columns trailing, and an empty K3 socket in the mark. The plate heads fade in and the six rows settle in reading order (70ms stagger).

state change (the orchestrated moment, at 2.4s): the segmented control's ink fill moves from Before to After (420ms --ease-inout). Both voices fade out (200ms). The plates re-proportion across the seam from 7 | 5 to 5 | 7 columns (900ms --ease-inout), with the paper plate narrowing and the ink plate widening. The voices then return at their new sizes row by row (420ms, 60ms stagger). Last, the red K3 core drops into its socket in the mark (400ms), which is the installed beat. The switch finishes by about 4.4s.

interaction: Before | After are real buttons (aria-pressed), and either direction replays the same fade → re-proportion → return sequence (the core lifts first when going back). Hovering a row lifts its mono index from --fg-2 to --fg.
on the live site: the figure advances from Before to After once, when it is 50% visible, and the reader can toggle it. With reduced motion the resting After state shows and there is no demo.
notes: Figure numbering follows the A order (hero 01 … assets 08, before/after 09, CTA 10, footer 11). Both voices are always on screen, so the final frame still reads as six without → with pairs. Red is limited to the label squares, the 48×2 rule and the K3 core. Coherence pass: the doors were removed from this head (the FAQ and the final CTA follow immediately, so three asks in a row read as pressure), and the annotation now uses the hero's grammar (red square + caps label) instead of a mono key on a hairline. Arrows are drawn as SVG because the brand fonts carry no ↗ / → glyphs. Direction-coherence pass: A's one section rhythm is 112px top / 96px bottom in the render (160/160 on the live site); the head grammar is the hero's — Mona 500 11px tracked-caps label with an 8px red square (mono FIG. number at right), 96px two-voice statement on the display tokens with exactly one light phrase, 48×2 red rule, 20px lede in cols 1–6 (≤ 50ch, ≤ 3 lines), optional quiet door, and the founder's bottom-right annotation; FIG. numbers run 01–11 in homepage order; segmented controls are 11px tracked caps.
